slots_and_copies.name: slot_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Validated first at boot (0x08000620->0x080005d4); if invalid but slot_1 valid, loaded from slot_1 and repaired by rewrite (0x08000678->0x08000648)

slots_and_copies.name: slot_1
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Validated second at boot (0x08000634->0x080005d4); fallback source for repair; rewritten unconditionally every boot (0x0800068c->0x08000648). No generation counter; slot_0 wins when both valid

checksums.name: block_u32_sum
checksums.formula_detail: sum (mod 2^32) of all 257 u32_le words of the 0x404 block with the stored word at +0x08 zeroed during computation; reader accepts iff sum_as_read == 2*stored

io_driver_functions.notes: SRAM->RAM; sets WAITCNT (|3), stages stack copy stub, delegates to external 0x080f49c8; called as func_0x so absent from callgraph callers
RAM->SRAM byte-by-byte copy after WAITCNT (|3) setup; canonical SRAM writer
Sums len>>2 u32_le words, returns u32
Reads block to RAM mirror, checks MIW magic (0x08007c2c, 4 bytes), returns 0 valid / 1 bad magic / 2 bad checksum (total==2*stored)
Zeroes +0x08, recomputes checksum via 0x080004f4, stores it, byte-copies RAM mirror to SRAM via 0x080eeeb0
Default-save constructor: DMA-zeroes 0x404 RAM mirror, strcpy MIW, sets +0x04=0x404, +0x0c const, byte+0x20|=2, seeds records 15-22 via 0x08008aa8, sets byte+0x1ff=1
RAM-mirror score updater: record at mirror+idx*8+0x20 (idx<28); type1 descending top-3 u16 at +2/+4/+6, type2 u32 at +2; gameplay callers not in traced corpus
